title: Class maps and proof certificates
objective: Implement abstract class-group presentation/maps, ideal discrete logarithms, principality witnesses, GRH proof labels, unconditional Minkowski proof records, and mutation tests

handoff.summary: Adds a CPython-parseable IdealClassGroup with Sage-compatible invariant coordinates, generator ideals, multiplicative class elements, bidirectional ideal maps, exact quotient discrete-log witnesses, principality results, and duck-typed ClassUnitGroupContext/RelationPresentation construction. Adds immutable exact proof labels, serialized principal witnesses, externally replayed GRH records, exact-rational unconditional Minkowski prime-stream records, saturation records, and 13 one-field corruption mutations. Focused compiled tests also exercise a genuine nonzero Sage.js fractional ideal.
risks: Public NumberField and NumberFieldIdeal method wiring is outside this lane's claims and remains an integration task.

Conditional replay intentionally requires context.verify_conditional_grh_record(record); unconditional replay requires the documented field/order fingerprint, exact bound, ideal-fingerprint, and complete Minkowski-prime iterator hooks.
The broad pnpm test:baselib:strict and pnpm test:native contract gates were deferred to central integration by coordinator direction; focused compiled and standalone strict-Pyright receipts pass.
next_steps: Adapt ClassUnitGroupContext to expose the documented generator ideals, relation witnesses, ideal_class_log, proof record, theorem/bound, and replay hooks.

Use RelationPresentation.invariants and verify() from class-matrix commit 5cbd0c2aafaa9af4be84d38c0635a94923c917ab; generator_transforms can recover factor-base ideal products in the integration lane.
Run the broad strict/native and four-platform gates after all class/unit lanes are merged, then move this contract from active to review.
